plugins.name: bad-research
plugins.description: Deep, multi-source, fully-cited research. Tier-adaptive: a bounded question gets a fast cited answer; a broad or contested one gets the full adversarially-reviewed report with every claim bound to a source. Prompt skills + 17 agents load instantly; the Python `bad` engine self-bootstraps on first use (needs Python 3.11-3.13 and uv or pipx).
